# `company.shipment_lines`

Immutable shipment lines per revision; line_identity is stable across revisions.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this immutable line row. |
| `revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with revision_id + position | — | shipment_revisions.id | Shipment revision this line belongs to. |
| `shipment_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | shipments.id | Shipment of the revision. |
| `line_identity` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipment_lines_identity | — | Stable identity of the shipment line across revisions. |
| `position` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with revision_id + position | — | — | One-based position within the revision. |
| `root_document_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipment_lines_root | — | Billing root document of the order line shipped (the order, or the estimate it came from). |
| `root_line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipment_lines_root | — | Billing root line identity of the order line shipped. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | items.id | Item shipped. |
| `quantity_microunits` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Quantity shipped in the item's base unit, microunits. |
| `bin_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | inventory_bins.id | Bin the units left from as the line named it; null when none was named. |
| `description` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Line description: the order line's. |
| `asset_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | accounts.id | Inventory asset account the units left. |
| `cogs_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | accounts.id | Cost of goods sold account the cost moves to when billed. |
| `class_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | classes.id | Class of the order line; null when none. |
| `movement_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | ix_shipment_lines_movement | inventory_movements.id | Issue movement this line stands behind in this revision; null on a void. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this shipment line was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this shipment line. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this shipment line. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this shipment line. |
